[C] FloatingBox variants
|-- Controller canvas state retains floating panes
|   |-- ~ DisplayState = { rootIds: string[], nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane> }
|   |-- addDisplayNode attaches a root or adds it to a parent's childIds
|   |-- removeDisplayNode removes descendants and repairs active-child links
|   `-- ~ setExpansion -> save/restore expandedGeometry
|-- Pane geometry is mutable through display helpers
|   |-- ~ geometry = position + bounds + coordinateSpace
|   |-- ~ geometryPolicy = placement: automatic|manual, sizing: content|fixed
|   `-- Measurement skips invalid sizes and expanded panes with fixed sizing
|-- SelectionRegion captures context for its panels
|   |-- ~ kind: 'selection'; sourceBoxId + sourceContentId + sourceAscii + rect
|   |-- Membership belongs to SelectionState, not this captured panel context
|   `-- ~ selectedIds + sourceRevisionId? + displayMode + activeChildId?
|-- ProjectedPane retains a projection result or source view
|   |-- ~ content.kind = call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
|   |-- Revision IDs and projectionId identify referenced material
|   `-- SourcePaneViewState manages live scroll; content.scroll is a checkpoint
|-- ConversationPane retains its thread and draft
|   |-- ~ kind: 'conversation'; thread + draft + presentation + canvasAnchor
|   `-- The semantic anchor is independent of expanded or docked geometry
|-- DetailPane retains display text
|   `-- ~ kind: 'detail'; title + ascii + sectionId?
`-- Arrows and unified display nodes are derived
